system: mixed system of Anglo-Saxon law and Islamic law

constitution.history: promulgated by royal decree 6 November 1996 (the Basic Law of the Sultanate of Oman serves as the constitution); amended by royal decree in 2011
constitution.amend: promulgated by the sultan or proposed by the Council of Oman and drafted by a technical committee as stipulated by royal decree and then promulgated through royal decree

courts.judges: judges nominated by the 9-member Supreme Judicial Council (chaired by the monarch) and appointed by the monarch; judges appointed for life
courts.lower: Courts of Appeal; Administrative Court; Courts of First Instance; sharia courts; magistrates' courts; military courts

citizenship.descent: the father must be a citizen of Oman

world: has not submitted an ICJ jurisdiction declaration; non-party state to the ICCt
